ground_truth_root_cause: The ad-service deploy in SHA 5acdff618e47 (2026-05-05T08:11:45Z) modified src/adservice/internal/personalization/engine.go and variant_b_config.go as part of Podman support changes. This introduced an off-by-one bug in the VariantEngine.Compute() method at engine.go:214, where the variant-B worker pool iterates to index 14 on a slice of length 14 (0-indexed), causing repeated 'index out of range [14] with length 14' panics. All variant-B worker goroutines crash in sequence, the worker pool drains to zero, the HTTP handler stalls with pending requests, goroutines leak, heap is exhausted, and the pod enters an OOMKill crash loop. The frontend (which is itself healthy) observes cascading timeouts then connection-refused errors, opens its circuit breaker for the ad-service personalization endpoint, and degrades to stale cached fallback ads.
ground_truth_remediation: 1. Immediately: roll back SHA 5acdff618e47 on ad-service to the previous stable image (SHA 2b9113d98e20 baseline) to stop the crash loop — estimated < 10 minutes. 2. Verify ad-service pod restarts cleanly and /healthz returns 200. 3. Frontend circuit breaker will auto-transition to half-open on next probe cycle (≤5 min); confirm successful half-open probe closes the circuit and personalization variant B resumes. 4. Ad-service team must fix the off-by-one in engine.go:214 (change loop bound from `len(pool)` to `len(pool)-1` or use range idiom) and re-deploy after validation. 5. Add an integration test covering variant-B worker pool initialization with boundary-length config slices.
